rules: Sample: one entry per pattern, row and side (grade.py). Bars from grade.py: promotion at mean CLV > 0 and t >= 2.5 at 15+ (t >= 2.0 at 20+). Learning phase: early-negative means still collecting, never a retirement call. A feature at a bar is a lead for review; this file never changes a pattern. Win rate never counts.

notCollected.public-pct: Needs a betting-splits source (Action Network or VSiN pages, or a paid splits API), pulled near the open and near kickoff per game. No free API in the stack today.
notCollected.guru: Needs a list of X/Reddit accounts and a reader (Reddit API is free with an app key; X API is paid). Log account, number, time, result; keep after 20 settled calls beat the close (MISSION.md).

gradedCoverage.note: needs Pinnacle on the same line
needs a stored snap 30m-6h before the pick

featureTiming.role: pre-pick (line and price at the pick)
featureTiming.keyNumber: pre-pick (line at the pick and fair)
featureTiming.moveBeforePick: pre-pick (open snapshot vs line at the pick)
featureTiming.edgeBar: pre-pick (edge and bar at the pick)
featureTiming.injury: pre-pick (contextAtPick or the read's reason text only)
featureTiming.wind: pre-pick (contextAtPick, or a row forecast whose asOf is before the pick)
featureTiming.steamBeforePick: pre-pick (stored snap 30m-6h before the pick vs pinAtPick)

autopsy.note: Post-pick. Causes explain why reads lost to the close; verdicts and tags explain results. Nothing here is a feature or a rule: a cause becomes testable only through its pre-pick feature.
